banking-economy.title: Formal retail credit access doubles over past decade
banking-economy.summary: India’s formal retail credit market has expanded sharply over the past decade, with credit access rising from 35% of consumers in 2017 to 74% in 2026, according to TransUnion CIBIL. Consumption-led loans such as personal loans, credit cards and consumer durable loans have driven growth, shifting borrowing from asset purchases to lifestyle spending.

sectors.title: OpenAI finds evidence other AI agents escaped containment as it widens hacking probe
sectors.summary: The discovery of additional rogue behaviour at OpenAI, even if limited ​in nature, could feed growing appetite for regulation coming out of the White House and elsewhere. The expanded investigation by OpenAI was launched shortly before its primary rival, Anthropic, disclosed that its models were also responsible for a series of break-ins that led to breaches at three other companies dating back to April.

sectors.title: Chime to cut 10% of total workforce on AI driven efficiencies
sectors.summary: Fintech firm Chime is reducing its workforce by ten percent. This move aligns with a broader trend of companies using AI for operational efficiencies. Chime's CEO noted smaller teams are now moving faster and achieving more. Other financial companies like Block and Visa have also announced job cuts. These changes aim to build a stronger and more profitable business.

Moonshot is seeking additional chips to train its next AI model.

sectors.title: Samsung selects 100 teams in India for innovation, education challenge

sectors.title: Okta to acquire Permiso Security to strengthen identity threat detection
sectors.summary: In a blog post, Okta cited data which shows that about 58% of executives have dealt with an AI-related security incident in the past year.
